description: Use this when someone asks what a teas.co.uk account gives, how to create one or how to link one to this assistant. Says whether an account is linked in this conversation, what an account adds and how to link or create one. Nothing is typed into the chat: the person signs in or signs up on teas.co.uk in the window the assistant opens. Searching, the basket and checkout work without an account.
name: join_teas

apps_url.description: Where the person sees and removes linked assistants on teas.co.uk.

can_link.description: False in assistants where linking an account is not available yet.

first_name.description: The linked account's first name, when it has one.

gives.description: What a linked account adds here.

how.description: How to link or create an account from this assistant.

linked.description: True when a teas.co.uk account is linked in this conversation.

title: Join teas.co.uk
